newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X down in heavy trading.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X down in heavy trading.

text.p: Bre-X Minerals Ltd shares were active again on Wednesday as investors digested reports last week about a dispute over its huge gold discovery in Indonesia, analysts said.
More than 1.7 million shares traded by midday, with the stock down 0.25 to 25.05.

Analysts said market players were adjusting their positions after Toronto's Globe and Mail reported last week that an Indonesian company with a 10 percent stake in part of the Busang property was claiming a share of the rest of the deposit.
Bre-X has said the claims are without merit.
The stock is volatile as investors tried to make sense of the issue, said mining analyst Michael Fowler with Levesque Beaubien Geoffrion.
"Probably a lot of people dropped out and other people are taking the opposite view. They're buying," he said. "So you've got high volume."
The stock is sticking to its regular price range despite the heavy trading, said analyst Steve Walker with Gordon Capital.
